+def _dependency_resolver(data, name_order, preference):
+    packages = data["packages"]
+    names = sorted(packages, reverse=(name_order == "descending"))
+    features = set(data.get("features", []))
+    blocked = data.get("blocked", {})
+    pins = data.get("pins", {})
+
+    domains = []
+    for name in names:
+        versions = [row["version"] for row in packages[name]
+                    if row["version"] not in blocked.get(name, [])
+                    and (name not in pins or row["version"] == pins[name])]
+        versions = sorted(set(versions), reverse=(preference == "maximum"))
+        domains.append([-1] + versions if preference == "minimum" else versions + [-1])
+
+    roots = data["roots"]
+    for values in product(*domains):
+        selected = {name: version for name, version in zip(names, values)
+                    if version != -1}
+        valid = True
+        for name, bounds in roots.items():
+            version = selected.get(name)
+            if version is None or not bounds[0] <= version <= bounds[1]:
+                valid = False
+                break
+        if not valid:
+            continue
+
+        edges = {}
+        closure = set(roots)
+        for name, version in selected.items():
+            row = next(row for row in packages[name] if row["version"] == version)
+            active = []
+            for dep in row.get("deps", []):
+                feature = dep.get("feature", "")
+                if feature and feature not in features:
+                    continue
+                active.append(dep)
+                target = selected.get(dep["name"])
+                if target is None or not dep["min"] <= target <= dep["max"]:
+                    valid = False
+                    break
+                closure.add(dep["name"])
+            edges[name] = [dep["name"] for dep in active]
+            if not valid:
+                break
+        if not valid or closure != set(selected):
+            continue
+
+        finished, active_path = set(), set()
+
+        def visit(node):
+            if node in active_path:
+                return False
+            if node in finished:
+                return True
+            active_path.add(node)
+            if any(not visit(child) for child in edges.get(node, [])):
+                return False
+            active_path.remove(node)
+            finished.add(node)
+            return True
+
+        if not all(visit(node) for node in edges):
+            continue
+        return {"versions": selected}
+    return {"error": "unsatisfiable"}
+
